headline: Dow drops below a key chart level, warning of more trouble ahead
detail: This is a significant bearish signal for the broader market. As a margin trader, a general market downturn will amplify losses across your tech/chip portfolio, making drawdowns extra painful.
rec: This reinforces the need to address your "SELL" and "TRIM" flagged positions. Strongly consider reducing exposure to SOXL, SPAL, QQQ, SMH, and QQQI to mitigate amplified losses.
